component.name: Still
component.summary: A quiet browser based on Helium

description.p: Still is a personal fork of Helium and Chromium with an Ink interface, a left tab rail, grayscale pages, and color on demand.
Local site controls provide custom blocked domains, allowed exceptions, and an optional adult-domain list. Settings stay on this device.
Still builds on the work of the Helium, Chromium, and ungoogled-chromium authors. Their attribution and licenses are retained.
